answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and registers a plot. A zephyr kite on one anchor lifts a keyed camera over the plot in zephyr wind, filing tether length, angle, frame. The auditor recomputes delta-plot area from length and angle on the public trig table, burning the bond on any area or key mismatch. The first flight costs 32, the kth 32+6(k-1), the 1000th 6026; 1000 fakes pay 3,029,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-kite ring fails: its frame carries another key, and a reused anchor serial forfeits both bonds. An honest agent pays 32 once and reclaims it after an audit of its delta plot.
